Name: Prismatic Bomb
Author: SoapTastes0K
Description:
[size=5][b]Prismatic Bomb[/b][/size]
A standalone, craft-only endgame explosive built for deep Skull Cavern, Mine, and Volcano Dungeon runs. Designed to expand beyond vanilla Mega Bombs and Iridium Bombs with exact drop-tile centering, a 3-stage prismatic cluster shockwave, low-end performance optimizations, and clean Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) customization—without modifying any vanilla or third-party mod assets.

[size=4][b]Preview[/b][/size]
[center][youtube]h0boKR5Cin8[/youtube][/center]

[size=4][b]Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]True Centered Blast (Default: 25-Tile Radius):[/b] Fixes Stardew Valley's large-radius explosion shifting bug so every detonation radiates cleanly from the exact tile where you dropped it (configurable from 5 to 100 tiles).[/*]
[*][b]3-Stage Cluster Shockwave (Default: 999 + 499 + 499):[/b] Triggers an initial 999-damage blast followed by two rapid 499-damage shockwaves (0.22s apart) that permanently eliminate collapsed Mummies, split Slimes, and tough late-game enemies.[/*]
[*][b]Low-End Performance & Debris Merging:[/b] Uses sparse object/terrain scanning, expanding multi-tick shockwaves, capped viewport-culled explosion visuals, and lossless stackable loot debris merging so massive 25–100 tile blasts run smoothly on laptops, Steam Deck, and mobile devices. Switch live between [i]Low-End[/i], [i]Balanced[/i] (default), and [i]Full[/i] presets in GMCM.[/*]
[*][b]Bypasses Armored Bug Immunity:[/b] Toggleable option lets Prismatic Bombs clear Armored Bugs caught inside the blast radius.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Detonation Delay (Default: 7s):[/b] Adjustable from 0s (instant) to 10s so you have time to clear the 25-tile danger zone, complete with looping vanilla fuse audio, an accelerating prismatic pulse animation, and vanilla explosion audio.[/*]
[*][b]Lethal Self-Damage (Configurable):[/b] Enabled by default using full blast damage so you have to respect the fuse even with high Defense, while respecting the Statue of the Dwarf King's [i]"Bombs cannot damage you"[/i] blessing (configurable)—or switch to Custom Self-Damage / disable self-damage in GMCM.[/*]
[*][b]Full Terrain & Flooring Clearing (Optional Protection):[/b] Clears stones, ore nodes, crates, weeds, twigs, trees, grass, and placed flooring tiles across the entire blast circle while keeping Treasure Room chests and spawned floor forage safe. Both [i]Protect Flooring Tiles[/i] and [i]Protect Farms & Buildings[/i] are [b]disabled by default[/b] for true vanilla bomb risk—toggle either on in GMCM if you want safety locks. Right-clicking ladders, shafts, or chests while holding the bomb will not waste a bomb.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to Unlock & Craft[/b][/size]
The Prismatic Bomb itself is [b]craft-only[/b] and cannot be purchased directly.
[list]
[*][b]Recipe Unlock (Default):[/b] Sold at the [b]Volcano Dwarf Shop[/b] (Volcano Dungeon Level 5) for [b]999 Prismatic Shards[/b] (0g). Uncheck [i]Require Volcano Shop Unlock[/i] in GMCM if you prefer the recipe auto-unlocked upon loading.[/*]
[*][b]Crafting Recipe (Yields 1 Prismatic Bomb):[/b]
- 10 Prismatic Shards
- 5 Battery Packs
- 10 Mega Bombs
- 15 Bombs
- 20 Cherry Bombs[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]GMCM Configuration Options[/b][/size]
All changes apply live when clicking Save (no restart required):
[list]
[*][b]Performance & Visuals:[/b] Performance Preset (Low-End / Balanced [default] / Full), Merge Explosion Loot Debris (On), Till Diggable Dirt (Core Only [7] / Full Radius / Off), Reduce Screen Flash (Off)[/*]
[*][b]Explosion & Fuse:[/b] Blast Radius (25), Detonation Delay (7s, range 0–10s)[/*]
[*][b]Cluster Damage:[/b] Primary Blast Damage (999), Enable Cluster Effect (On), Cluster Follow-Up Pulses (2), Cluster Pulse Damage (499), Cluster Pulse Interval (0.22s)[/*]
[*][b]Safety & Environment:[/b] Damage Player (On), Respect Dwarf Statue Immunity (On), Use Blast Damage For Self (On), Custom Self-Damage (150), Kill Mummies (On), Kill Armored Bugs (On), Protect Flooring Tiles (Off), Protect Farms & Buildings (Off)[/*]
[*][b]Recipe Unlock:[/b] Require Volcano Shop Unlock (On)[/*]
[/list][i]Testing / Debug Console Command:[/i]
[code]give_prismatic_bomb [count][/code]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+ & SMAPI 4.0+[/b] (zero Harmony patches; 100% standalone C# SMAPI mod).[/*]
[*][b]Iridium Bombs by ApryllForever:[/b] Fully compatible out of the box! Both mods use isolated item/recipe IDs and append cleanly side by side in the Volcano Dwarf Shop without overwriting each other.[/*]
[*][b]Single-Player Tested:[/b] Built and verified for single-player; multiplayer synchronization has not been tested yet.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (and optionally [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]).[/*]
[*]Install via Vortex (recommended) or extract the
[code]PrismaticBomb[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[b]v1.1.1 — Dwarf Statue Immunity Fix[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Prismatic Bomb self-damage bypassing the Statue of the Dwarf King's [i]"Bombs cannot damage you"[/i] blessing on primary and cluster shockwaves.[/*]
[*]Added [b]Respect Dwarf Statue Immunity[/b] toggle (On by default) under [i]Safety & Environment[/i] in GMCM.[/*]
[/list][spoiler]
[b]v1.1.0 — Performance & Optimization Update[/b]
[list]
[*]Added [b]Performance Preset[/b] in GMCM ([i]Low-End[/i], [i]Balanced[/i] [default], and [i]Full[/i]) with expanding multi-tick shockwaves, capped viewport-culled explosion sprites, trimmed vanilla core radius, and cosmetic pebble limits.[/*]
[*]Added [b]Merge Explosion Loot Debris[/b] (On by default) to combine duplicate stackable blast drops (stone, ores, coal, gems, geodes) into compact stacked pickups with zero loot loss.[/*]
[*]Added [b]Till Diggable Dirt[/b] option ([i]Core Only [7][/i] default, [i]Full Radius[/i], or [i]Off[/i]) to stop massive blasts from flooding sandy floors with excess HoeDirt tiles.[/*]
[*]Added [b]Reduce Screen Flash[/b] toggle in GMCM to soften bright white detonation flashes.[/*]
[*]Removed redundant full-circle terrain/dirt scans on cluster follow-up pulses and switched object/terrain clearing to sparse dictionary scanning.[/*]
[/list][b]v1.0.0 — Initial Release[/b]
[list]
[*]Initial standalone release for Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Added craft-only Prismatic Bomb with centered 25-tile radius, 3-stage cluster shockwave (999 + 499 + 499), Volcano Dwarf Shop recipe unlock, and GMCM support.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
